dog.description_text:
Please note: Any profiles with a "Pawling, NY" icon are located at the ASPCA Recovery & Rehabilitation Center, which is a 90-minute drive outside of the city. All other dogs are located in New York City.

Meet Boots, a charming gentleman with a playful side!

Boots loves spending time with his canine friends but he’s just as happy curling up on the couch for cuddles with his favorite people. When he’s excited to head outside, he shows it with some adorable full-body wiggles!

Boots also knows a few basic cues and loves working for tasty treats. Training is another fun way to spend quality time with this sweet guy!

Ready to make room on the couch for Boots? Click the “Adopt Me” button to connect with Boots’ team in Pawling, New York.

*We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: BOOTS
